svg.title: EP2 C4 AREA 24
svg.desc: Matching colors: switches / fences Clock: timed switch Bulb: light control Green ring: healing Crossed squares: barriers / traps Box numbers: supply counts Letter / prime: warp pair West team takes A after 1a/1b, goes east to disable poison, then south along the hall to room 2. East team takes 1c/1d/1e and defeats Delbiter. In 1f, skip inactive boxes and continue north to B. Finish room 2’s pads with both teams, then clear room 3’s squids. Defeat the Sinow in 4 and head east. Break the barriers along the long 4 → 5 hallway. After room 5, use the east exit.
